15f7d70e-cd56-426b-852d-478d5c65cb5f.plaintext: This holds across the range of devices people actually use: desktop monitors, laptops, tablets in either orientation, phones of every size, and browsers with text scaled up for readability.

379ad9af-f9b2-44a7-80f5-fb62c53446fa.plaintext: The site uses pages that adapt to whatever screen they are opened on. Rather than maintaining a separate mobile version, the layout responds to the space available: columns that sit side by side on a wide monitor stack into a single column on a phone, images scale to the width they are given, and navigation collapses into a menu when there is no room for a full bar.

b793f7c9-9481-4973-95e9-49be43d5c2d8.plaintext: Content is written and published once. An editor adds a page without deciding how it should look on a tablet or a phone — the same content is delivered to every visitor, and the presentation adjusts on its own.
